refnamediv.refpurpose: Checks whether the watcher is still registered

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
public boolIo\Poll\Watcher::isActive
A watcher is active from the moment it is created by Io\Poll\Context::add. It becomes inactive when it is removed with Io\Poll\Watcher::remove, when its stream is closed, or when its context is destroyed.
A watcher that uses Io\Poll\Event::OneShot stays active after it was triggered.
